title: Chinese spy suspect walks free after Prague court acquittal, while Czech spy suspect in China remains behind bars
lede: Yang Yiming, a suspected Chinese spy, has walked free after a Czech court acquitted him, but prosecutors have appealed the verdict. However, Czech national Aleš K. is still behind bars in China for allegedly breaching the country's security laws.
